automation.title: Scheduled tasks
automation.subtitle: Let Near work for you on a schedule.
automation.manageHint: Manage scheduled tasks so Near can work for you on a plan.
automation.preventSleepHint: Ask the system to delay sleep so long-running tasks, lid-closed idle, or remote chains are less likely to be suspended. Near stops requesting this after you quit.
automation.runTriggered: Started in a new session. Expand this task to see the last result, or open its pane in the sidebar for the latest chat.
automation.emptyHint: Start from a template above, or click “Add task” to create one
automation.enableHint: Run on the schedule when enabled
automation.noLogs: No log yet (the task has not run, or it was just recreated).
automation.name: Name
automation.execModelHint: (optional; uses the Studio default if unset. Each run starts a new session.)
automation.defaultModel: Default (same as the current main-window model)
automation.needApiKey: Configure an API key and enable models in Settings before they appear here.
automation.dateRangeHint: (optional; leave empty to stay always on.)
automation.deleteConfirmLegacy: Delete this scheduled task? This cannot be undone.
automation.deleteFilesMessage: Also delete this task’s files in the crontask directory?
automation.runtimeHint: Cap tool rounds per chat and how many workspace folders each avatar or Meta can bind (including the default). Click Quit at the bottom of the window to write local settings.
automation.mentionHops: Group @mention hop count (default 2) can be set in
automation.opsHint: On by default. In chat you can call get_trace / get_logs / get_recent_changes / get_session_review / get_umodel / sync_changeplane / get_trace_parity / get_channel_slo by session ID. Click Quit at the bottom to save, then fully quit and restart Near.
automation.maxWorkspacesHint: Includes 1 default workspace. Folders you add under the same avatar or Meta share this cap.
automation.toolSearchHint: The first round only exposes core tools. Extra tools load after the model searches for them, which saves context. Off matches the old behavior. Changes write to local settings immediately.
automation.autoThresholdHint: On-demand loading starts only when the full schema exceeds this value. It is independent of the model context window.
automation.hotCacheRatio: Deferred-tool hot cache share of window (%)
automation.hotCacheHint: Only limits how much of the window already-loaded deferred tools may use (128k ≈ {{example128k}}, 200k ≈ {{example200k}}, 1M capped at {{max}}). It does not decide whether on-demand loading is on.
automation.tokenBudgetHint: Cap cumulative tokens for a session and tokens for a single turn. Hitting the session cap hard-stops the run; unattended continue cannot bypass it. Click Quit at the bottom and restart the backend to apply.
automation.stallHint: Controls the progress warning, the top “may be interrupted” hint, and optional auto-continue. Click Quit at the bottom of the window after changing.
automation.stallWarnHint: After this many seconds with no SSE or tool progress, show “no response for Ns” and an interrupt hint (default 90 seconds).
automation.autoNudgeHint: When a stall warning is already showing, send a continue nudge automatically (no user bubble). Supports running / interrupted / channel C. Unattended mode is handled below by “Finish tasks unattended” and the backend Supervisor. Off by default.
automation.nudgeBelow: Auto-continue wait should be at least the stall threshold; it will be raised to {{seconds}} seconds on save.
automation.llmPatience: Wait and retry on model timeout
automation.llmPatienceHint: Do not fail immediately when the model times out. The UI shows a “network is slow, this may take longer” buffer, retries with exponential backoff, and continues this turn when the network returns—no need to click Resume. A failure card appears only after the budget is spent. On by default.
automation.unattendedHint: After the global switch is on, you can enable unattended mode per session. Supervisor continues in the background (even after you close the window). It only applies to the current session and will not answer new questions for you. Pair it with Auto-continue above: that is an in-app online nudge; this item is taken over by the backend.
automation.resumeExhausted: Auto-continue after tool rounds are exhausted
